name: Nashville Sheet Metal
old_description: Sam has been in sheet metal since 2007. His background is in Architectural & Roofing sheet metal, Sales, Estimating and Design. Sam currently heads up our BIM & Coordination Dept.
about:
Nashville Sheet Metal was founded in 2003 in Nashville, Tennessee. The company is now owned by Dexter Cross, who joined as an estimator and project manager in 2014 after graduating from Tennessee Technological University with a degree in manufacturing engineering technology. Cross assumed ownership after progressing through the organization.

The firm operates a full-service production shop providing HVAC ductwork fabrication, specialty fabrication and installation, custom design, industrial sheet metal services, and pre-construction services. Its capabilities extend to building information modeling (BIM) and coordination using Revit and Trimble technologies, field measuring, welding, and stainless steel fabrication for food manufacturing equipment. A shop manager oversees a crew of welders and fabricators.

The company serves commercial, industrial, and specialty food manufacturing clients across the Middle Tennessee region. Projects include architectural and roofing sheet metal, HVAC systems, and custom stainless steel installations for food processing facilities. Long-term personnel such as Darryl Underwood, with over 35 years in the trade, and field superintendents Raymond Davis and Sean Monahan support project execution.

Nashville Sheet Metal emphasizes quality, service, and safety as core values, citing over 150 years of combined industry experience among its team. The company states it reinvests in people and technology to remain competitive in a changing market.
